monster:Twoflower.visualDescription: A lightly dressed traveler wears a brown brimmed hat, bright blue-purple patterned shirt, tan shorts, and small shoes.
monster:Twoflower.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Twoflower as the Tourist quest leader.
monster:Twoflower.modelBrief: Model a cheerful tourist with straw hat, colorful short-sleeved shirt, shorts, and casual stance; echo the Tourist role without copying it exactly.

monster:Norn.visualDescription: A red-haired woman in a long dark brown cloak stands with a strong upright stance and warm red inner garment.
monster:Norn.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Norn as the Valkyrie quest leader and a powerful human woman.
monster:Norn.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall mature woman with red hair, dark cloak, reddish dress or armor, and grounded commanding posture.

monster:Neferet the Green.visualDescription: A dark-faced hooded sorceress wears bright emerald robes and raises a staff with a violet orb.
monster:Neferet the Green.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Neferet the Green as the Wizard quest leader, a strong human spellcaster.
monster:Neferet the Green.modelBrief: Build a robed mage with vivid green hood and layered skirt, dark face shadow, and purple-topped staff.

monster:Minion of Huhetotl.visualDescription: A lean crimson demon with long arms, pointed ears or horns, and a red loincloth holds a staff or blade in one hand.
monster:Minion of Huhetotl.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Minion of Huhetotl as the Archeologist quest nemesis and a unique major demon.
monster:Minion of Huhetotl.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall red demon with angular limbs, narrow head, dark claws, and an upright weapon; preserve the thin silhouette.

monster:Thoth Amon.visualDescription: A dark-robed sorcerer wears a gold crown or hood, raises both arms, and holds two green-glowing staff tips.
monster:Thoth Amon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Thoth Amon as the Barbarian quest nemesis, a covetous human spellcaster.
monster:Thoth Amon.modelBrief: Model a human mage in indigo and gold robes with raised arms and two green magical accents; retain the strong shoulder silhouette.

monster:Chromatic Dragon.visualDescription: A crouched dark blue dragon has bright magenta neck and wing, yellow-pink patterned membrane, and a massive horned head.
monster:Chromatic Dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Chromatic Dragon as the Cave Dweller quest nemesis and a unique dragon also known as Tiamat.
monster:Chromatic Dragon.modelBrief: Build a large multi-colored dragon with deep blue body, pink-magenta head and wings, golden membrane patches, heavy claws, and curled tail.

monster:Goblin King.visualDescription: A small olive-green goblin wears a tall gold crown and carries a dark sword, with a long nose and thin limbs.
monster:Goblin King.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki records the Goblin King as a former unique Elf quest nemesis.
monster:Goblin King.modelBrief: Model a spindly green goblin with oversized golden crown, pointed nose, and dark sword; label as legacy quest art.

monster:Cyclops.visualDescription: A huge bald orange-pink giant has one central eye, broad arms, round torso, and small brown loincloth.
monster:Cyclops.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Cyclops as the unique Healer quest nemesis and a giant.
monster:Cyclops.modelBrief: Sculpt a massive one-eyed humanoid with broad chest, pink-orange skin, huge hands, and simple loincloth.

monster:Ixoth.visualDescription: A tall crimson dragon rears with a long neck, wings, powerful hind legs, claws, and curling tail.
monster:Ixoth.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Ixoth as the unique red dragon guarding the Knight quest.
monster:Ixoth.modelBrief: Build a large red dragon with extended neck, raised wings, horned head, heavy claws, and long coiled tail; differentiate it from baby red dragons by scale.

monster:Master Kaen.visualDescription: A stern bare-armed human monk has pale skin, dark hair, gray upper wrap, red lower robe, and squared fighting pose.
monster:Master Kaen.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Master Kaen as the Monk quest nemesis, a human martial artist.
monster:Master Kaen.modelBrief: Model an older formidable monk with gray chest wrap, red trousers, exposed arms, and planted fighting stance.

monster:Nalzok.visualDescription: A gray-brown horned beastlike demon crouches with long clawed forelimbs, ridged back, and a broad red mouth.
monster:Nalzok.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Nalzok as the Priest quest nemesis and a unique major demon.
monster:Nalzok.modelBrief: Sculpt a powerful quadrupedal-looking demon with curved horns, heavy shoulders, gray-brown hide, and red maw; keep the low predatory pose.

monster:Scorpius.visualDescription: An enormous purple-black scorpion has huge pale front claws, curled segmented tail, and broad armored body.
monster:Scorpius.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Scorpius as the Ranger quest nemesis and a unique giant scorpion.
monster:Scorpius.modelBrief: Build a massive scorpion with thick violet carapace, oversized pale pincers, eight legs, and raised stinging tail.
